name: Sofitel Philippine Plaza Manila
short_description: A 5-star luxury resort with 607 rooms and suites on Manila Bay, next to the Cultural Center of the Philippines, with balconies showcasing sunset views over the bay.
ai_summary: Sofitel Philippine Plaza Manila is a 5-star luxury resort in a tropical setting on Roxas Boulevard, adjacent to the Cultural Center of the Philippines Complex and close to the SM Mall of Asia. It has 607 rooms and suites with balconies overlooking Manila Bay, known for sunset views, and sits about 5 minutes from both domestic and international airport terminals. Nearby attractions include Intramuros, Manila Cathedral, and the Philippine International Convention Center (PICC). No ALL Rating figure was shown on the property's own Accor page at the time of research. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
